name: SEXSTELLAR
source:
SEXSTELLAR: An adult visual novel where passion, doubt, and mystery collide. Stranded on a space station with the alluring Cassiopeia, you must survive, uncover secrets, and face the truth—one of you isn’t human. Can you trust yourself in this steamy sci-fi thriller?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3472100/SEXSTELLAR/]Steam[/url]]
